long.vo: India have won just two Test series in New Zealand, in fifty-eight years. The next one starts on the nineteenth of November, in Wellington. And India's best bowler has a problem there. Stay to the end, and we'll show you the number that could decide this series.

scene.kicker: INDIA IN NEW ZEALAND · 2 TESTS · FROM 19 NOV

long.vo: But first, make your call. Can India win this series? Comment one for a win, two for a drawn series, three for a New Zealand win. We'll check back at the end.

items.d: First series win in New Zealand since 2009

long.vo: Start with the history. India won here in nineteen sixty-eight, three-one. Then nothing for forty-one years, until MSD's side won in two thousand and nine. Since then, beaten in twenty fourteen, and beaten two-nil on the last tour, in twenty twenty.

head.t: INDIA'S RECENT TEST SERIES IN NEW ZEALAND

long.vo: In twenty-five Tests in New Zealand, India have won five, and lost ten. New Zealand beat them in the first World Test Championship final. And in twenty twenty-four, they beat India three-nil, in India.

tiles.l: LOST THE WTC FINAL TO NZ

long.vo: So why is New Zealand so hard? Look at who takes the wickets. Since twenty ten, in our archive, eighty-six per cent of Test wickets in New Zealand go to fast bowlers. In India, it's forty-four.

head.sub: SHARE OF TEST WICKETS TAKEN BY PACE · 2010-2025 · OUR ARCHIVE

long.vo: And India's batters feel it. Since two thousand and nine, they average thirty-five and a half runs per wicket in New Zealand. At home, forty-one. The ball does more, for longer.

head.sub: RUNS PER WICKET IN TESTS · 2009-2025 · OUR ARCHIVE

long.vo: The New Zealand plan is simple. Full, swinging and seaming with the new ball, a packed slip cordon, and patience. At the Basin Reserve, since twenty ten, the first-innings average is three hundred and thirty-nine, and batting first is no advantage: in twenty Tests, seven wins for the side batting first, eight for the side batting second.

scene.sub: Basin Reserve since 2010: first-innings average 339 · our archive

long.vo: Now the number we promised. जसप्रीत बुमराह averages nineteen point eight in Tests, in our archive. In New Zealand, in two Tests in twenty twenty, he took six wickets, at thirty-one point seven. That is the gap India have to close.

Can he fix it this time? It helps that the attack he faced has changed. Since two thousand and two, in our archive, the three New Zealand bowlers with the most Test wickets against India are Tim Southee, Trent Boult and एजाज़ पटेल. None of them is in this squad.

head.sub: NZ BOWLERS' TEST WICKETS AGAINST INDIA · SINCE 2002 · OUR ARCHIVE

long.vo: The man to watch is Kyle Jamieson. Tall, and relentless: he gets bounce from a good length. He has twenty-two Test wickets against India, in our archive, and he was player of the match when New Zealand won the World Test Championship final.

scene.note: extra bounce from a good length

long.vo: Alongside him: Matt Henry, Jacob Duffy, Nathan Smith and Blair Tickner, with Mitchell Santner as the spinner. Tom Latham captains, and Devon Conway, रचिन रवींद्र and Tom Blundell are all racing to be fit.

items.d: 22 Test wickets against India · our archive

long.vo: India's squad changed this month. कुलदीप यादव has been released, and the pacer गुरनूर बराड़, with no Test caps, is in. That makes six fast bowlers. And only three of the sixteen have ever played a Test in New Zealand: बुमराह, जडेजा, and रिषभ पंत, who has rejoined the squad after clearing his fitness.

scene.label: INDIA'S SQUAD WHO HAVE PLAYED A TEST IN NEW ZEALAND · OUR ARCHIVE
scene.note: Bumrah, Jadeja, Pant · six fast bowlers in the squad

long.vo: The duel that could decide it? बुमराह against Tom Latham. In our archive, बुमराह has bowled a hundred and sixty-three balls to Latham. Seventy-nine runs. One dismissal. The New Zealand captain has held him off before.

head.sub: BUMRAH TO LATHAM IN TESTS · OUR ARCHIVE

long.vo: Our call? New Zealand at home are still favourites. But their attack is far less experienced, and India have the best bowler on either side, with a point to prove. We say one-all.

scene.sub: New Zealand favourites at home. Bumrah is India's equaliser.

long.vo: Now it's your turn. Remember your call? One, two or three. Tell us why in the comments, and we'll come back to it after the first Test. Subscribe, so you don't miss it.

short.vo: Can India win a Test series in New Zealand? They've done it twice, in fifty-eight years.
Their best bowler, जसप्रीत बुमराह, averages nineteen point eight in Tests. In New Zealand, thirty-one point seven.
And New Zealand's old attack is gone. Southee, Boult and एजाज़ पटेल, the top three wicket-takers against India since two thousand and two, are not in this squad. But Kyle Jamieson is.
